views.name: v_member_details
views.create_sql: /* Views thu cong cho database student_club (Paper V-SQL style) */ /* 1. View thong tin thanh vien kem nganh hoc va dia chi */ CREATE VIEW v_member_details AS SELECT member.member_id, member.first_name, member.last_name, member.email, member.position, member.t_shirt_size, member.phone, major.major_name, major.department AS major_department, major.college AS major_college, zip_code.city, zip_code.county, zip_code.state FROM member LEFT JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id LEFT JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code

views.name: v_event_budget
views.create_sql: /* 2. View thong tin su kien va ngan sach */ CREATE VIEW v_event_budget AS SELECT budget.budget_id, budget.category AS budget_category, budget.amount AS budget_amount, budget.spent AS budget_spent, budget.remaining AS budget_remaining, event.event_id, event.event_name, event.event_date, event.type AS event_type, event.location AS event_location, event.status AS event_status FROM budget LEFT JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id

views.name: v_expense_details
views.create_sql: /* 3. View chi phi kem thong tin ngan sach, su kien va thanh vien */ CREATE VIEW v_expense_details AS SELECT expense.expense_id, expense.expense_description, expense.expense_date, expense.cost, expense.approved, member.first_name AS member_first_name, member.last_name AS member_last_name, budget.category AS budget_category, event.event_name FROM expense LEFT JOIN budget ON expense.link_to_budget = budget.budget_id LEFT JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id LEFT JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id
